description: List the DOCUMENTS FILED in a US federal court case — complaints, motions, orders, exhibits — with a direct link to each PDF. Reads the free RECAP archive on the Internet Archive; no API key and no PACER fee. Give a docket_id from a docket search, or a court and docket number. Returns document links and docket-entry numbering, NOT document text. Coverage is partial (about 36% of dockets, higher in appellate courts) because RECAP holds only what PACER users have contributed.

court.description: Court id, e.g. "nysd" — use together with docket_number.

docket_id.description: Docket id from federal_civil_search, federal_criminal_search, bankruptcy_search or federal_appeal_search.

docket_number.description: Docket number as the court records it, e.g. "1:15-cv-02842".

name: recap_filings
title: Recap Filings
